title: Concept: Audit entry carrying the old and new value
description: An audit record with before and after copies of a personal field in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The audit trail keeps historical values that the customer asked to change, so exposing it in a response defeats the correction and keeps stale data readable.
applicability: Deployments that render an audit record with before and after copies of a personal field into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The audit trail keeps historical values that the customer asked to change, so exposing it in a response defeats the correction and keeps stale data readable.
